method: Compile the unchanged original highexit.inc with Microsoft MASM 6 in a synthetic BIOS macro context and link with two external data symbols placed at target-observed offsets.
limitations: BIOS macro definitions and external data providers are synthetic; final BIOS assembly, linking and source integration remain unverified.
The full unadapted sysconf.asm previously failed to compile with MASM 6, so this does not prove whole-file toolchain compatibility.
